description: MobileCapabilitiesService returns features.assets (asset:read) and features.assetAudit (asset:read AND asset:update) in the PSA product block; both false for other products
OpenAPI mobileCapabilitiesV1 documents the assets and assetAudit flags
Mobile FeatureCapabilities type + EMPTY_FEATURE_CAPABILITIES gain assets and assetAudit; parseFeatureCapabilities defaults them to false
DrawerNavigator renders AssetsTab only when features.assets is true, ProjectsTab only when features.projects is true
productSurfaceRegistry api_psa_only staticPrefixes include /api/v1/asset-audits; /api/v1/search confirmed listed in a group reachable with x-api-key
src/api/projects.ts listProjects(client, {apiKey, page, limit, project_name, status, client_id, assigned_to, is_closed}) → GET /api/v1/projects with pagination meta
getProject(client, {apiKey, projectId}) → GET /api/v1/projects/{id} typed with phases, assigned_user, client, counts

listProjectTasks(client, {apiKey, projectId}) → GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/tasks typed ProjectTaskSummary (task_id, phase_id, task_name, assigned_to, assigned_user_name, due_date, priority_id, project_status_mapping_id, wbs_code, is_closed)
createProjectTask(client, {apiKey, projectId, phaseId, body}) → POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/phases/{phaseId}/tasks; body requires task_name and project_status_mapping_id
Project types module exports ProjectStatus union and a statusTone(status) helper mapping to badge tones (planning/on_hold neutral, active/in_progress info, completed success, cancelled danger)

groupTasksByPhase(phases, tasks, statusMappings) pure helper returns phases in wbs order with tasks, doneCount, totalCount; tasks whose mapping is_closed count as done; tasks with unknown phase_id go to an 'Other' bucket last
projectProgress(phases) pure helper returns {done,total,ratio} with ratio 0 when total is 0
ProjectsScreen (drawer ProjectsTab, id projects-list) lists projects with name, client, status badge, end date and progress bar; paginates on end reached; pull to refresh
Search box filters by project_name (debounced 300ms); empty query clears

Filter sheet (id projects-filter-sheet) with status multi-select (default excludes completed and cancelled), client picker (EntityPickerModal), and 'Managed by me' toggle (assigned_to = current user id)
Filter state persisted per user like TicketsList filters and surfaced as a filter count badge on the header button
Empty state ('No projects match') with Clear filters; error state with Retry; offline shows cached first page
Row tap navigates to ProjectDetail { projectId, projectName }

ProjectDetailScreen (root stack 'ProjectDetail', id project-detail) loads getProject + listProjectTasks + listTaskStatusMappings in parallel and renders header: name, client (tap → ClientDetail), status badge, start/end dates, manager name
Phases render as sections in wbs order with 'n of m done' and a per-phase progress bar; project-level progress bar under the header
Task rows show name, assignee avatar/initials, due date (danger colour when past and not closed), status badge from the mapping label; tap → ProjectTaskDetail { taskId }
Closed tasks collapse under 'Show n completed' per phase (id project-phase-<phaseId>-show-completed)
Description collapsed with See more (reusing the ticket description expander)
Pull to refresh and resume refresh (useAppResume) reload the three calls; a task edit on ProjectTaskDetail invalidates the project cache so returning shows the change
Empty project (no phases) shows 'No phases yet. Add phases on the web.'

CreateTaskModal (id create-task-modal) with name (required), description, assignee (AgentPickerModal), due date (DatePickerField), priority (priorities list), estimated hours; Save disabled until name is non-empty
Create posts with project_status_mapping_id = first status mapping of the project (ordered by display order) and inserts the returned task into its phase without reload; toast on success
Each phase header '+' (id project-phase-<phaseId>-add-task) opens CreateTaskModal preselecting the phase; hidden when the create request returns 403 once (capability-less fallback)

ProjectTaskDetail gains a Details card: Assignee row (tap → AgentPickerModal, Unassign option), Due date row (tap → DatePickerField, Clear), Priority row (tap → priority picker), Estimated hours read-only
Edits call updateProjectTask with only the changed field, optimistic update, rollback + error toast on failure
'Open project' row at the top of ProjectTaskDetail navigates to ProjectDetail; header subtitle shows the project name (from the task's project_name)
Task detail reads 403 on PUT as read-only: edit rows render without chevrons and show 'Read only' hint

src/api/assets.ts listAssets(client, {apiKey, page, limit, search, client_id, location_id, status, asset_type}) → GET /api/v1/assets; listAssetStatuses → GET /api/v1/asset-statuses (slug, label, kind, display_order)
AssetsScreen (drawer AssetsTab, id assets-list) with search box (debounced), rows: name, asset tag, type icon, client, location, status badge; pagination; pull to refresh

Filter sheet (id assets-filter-sheet): client (EntityPickerModal), location (client locations, enabled after a client is chosen, cleared when client changes), status chips grouped by kind (default: all statuses with kind != archived), asset type
Status badge shows the registry label for the asset's slug; unknown slug (older server) shows the slug title-cased

Header actions: Scan (id assets-scan) navigates to InventoryTab scan view when features.inventory, else opens a scan-only modal using ScanView; Audit (id assets-audit) visible when features.assetAudit → AuditSetup
Empty, error and offline states consistent with Tickets; row tap → AssetDetail { assetId, assetName }
Assets tab 'Recent audits' row (id assets-recent-audits) lists the last 10 audits (client, location, date, present/missing) and opens AuditSummary

Migration creates asset_audits and asset_audit_items (tenant in PK, distributed by tenant via tenantDb.cjs, no RLS) and adds assets.last_audited_at timestamptz null + assets.last_audit_result text null

AssetAuditService.start(context, {client_id, location_id|null, statuses[]}) snapshots expected assets (tenant, client, location match incl. null, status in list), inserts the audit with expected_count, returns audit + expected items

AssetAuditService.markItem(context, auditId, {asset_id, result present|unexpected, method}) upserts the item (idempotent on tenant+audit+asset), validates audit in_progress and asset in tenant; an asset not in the expected snapshot is stored as unexpected regardless of requested result
AssetAuditService.unmarkItem removes an item; complete() inserts missing items for expected minus present, sets counts, status completed, completed_at

complete() writes one asset_history row per item (change_type 'audit', changes {audit_id, result, location_id, method}) and updates assets.last_audited_at/last_audit_result for present and missing assets, inside one transaction
cancel() sets status cancelled (only from in_progress); get() returns audit with items joined to asset name/tag/location; list() returns newest first with optional client_id filter and pagination

Routes: POST/GET /api/v1/asset-audits, GET /api/v1/asset-audits/{id}, POST /api/v1/asset-audits/{id}/items, DELETE /api/v1/asset-audits/{id}/items/{assetId}, POST /api/v1/asset-audits/{id}/complete, POST /api/v1/asset-audits/{id}/cancel via ApiAssetAuditController with zod schemas
Permissions: asset:read for list/get; asset:update for start, items, complete, cancel; mutations on a non in_progress audit return 409
OpenAPI route definitions for every audit endpoint; CE/EE specs and MCP/chat registries regenerated
src/api/assetAudits.ts wraps start, list, get, markItem, unmarkItem, complete, cancel with typed responses

AuditSetupScreen (root 'AuditSetup', id audit-setup): client picker, location picker (client locations + 'No location'), status chips by kind (default deployable + pending), live expected count via a dry listAssets count, Start button disabled until client chosen
AuditSessionScreen (root 'AuditSession' { auditId }, id audit-session) loads the audit, shows progress 'n of m present', segments Remaining / Present / Unexpected with counts

Scan button opens the camera scanner (reused ScanView scanner component) and resolves codes with lookupInventoryCode; an asset result in Remaining → markItem present (method scan) with haptic + toast; already-present asset → info toast; non-asset result → 'Not an asset' toast
Scan resolving to an asset outside the snapshot → markItem unexpected and the row appears under Unexpected with its real client/location
Scan resolving to nothing offers Register asset (existing RegisterAssetModal prefilled with the audit's client and location); on success the new asset is marked present with method register
Remaining rows have 'Mark present' (method manual); Present rows have 'Unmark' (unmarkItem); a search field filters Remaining by name/tag/serial

Finish asks for confirmation listing the remaining count when > 0, then calls complete and navigates to AuditSummary replacing the session route; Cancel audit in the header menu calls cancel after confirmation
Session screen reloads the audit from the server on mount and on resume; an audit found completed on reload redirects to its summary

AuditSummaryScreen (root 'AuditSummary' { auditId }, id audit-summary): counts, Missing list with per-row Create ticket (existing CreateTicketModal preselecting the asset), Unexpected list with real location, Present count, Done → Assets tab
AssetDetailScreen shows a 'Last audited' row (date, result, auditor) when last_audited_at is present
assets i18n namespace gains every audit string; no hardcoded text
HomeScreen (drawer 'HomeTab', first entry, id home) with cards Running timer, Today, My tickets, Activities, Quick actions; each card has its own loading/error row with Retry and collapses when empty

Drawer order: Home, Tickets, Activities, Schedule, Projects*, Interactions, Time Entries, Clients, Contacts, Assets*, Inventory*, Opportunities*, Settings; Home is initialRouteName; sign-in resets navigation to Home

My tickets card calls listTickets with assigned_to = current user, is_open=true, sort=latest_activity_at, limit=5, fields=mobile_list; header shows pagination.total; rows reuse the ticket list row; 'View all' opens TicketsTab with the assignee filter preset to me

Today card loads schedule entries for the device-local day (same window maths as useScheduleWeek), sorted by start; rows show time range and title; tap opens the Schedule tab's entry sheet for that entry type
Activities card loads activities due today or overdue (not done), 5 rows, 'View all' opens UserActivitiesTab
Running timer card shows the active work item title and elapsed (useTimerElapsedMs) with Stop opening the existing StopTimerModal; hidden when no timer runs

Quick actions: New ticket → CreateTicket; Scan → InventoryTab scan view (hidden when features.inventory is false); Log interaction → LogInteractionEntry flow; Start timer → ServicePickerModal then start with no work item (hidden while a timer runs)
Cards read from TTL cache (homeCache.ts, 5 min) when offline with the offline banner; pull to refresh and useAppResume refresh all cards
Home header: search icon (id home-search) → SearchScreen; existing HeaderTimerChip stays
home i18n namespace

searchableTypes(features) pure helper returns ticket, client, contact always; asset when features.assets; project and project_task when features.projects

SearchScreen (root 'Search', id search): auto-focused field, 300ms debounce, min 2 chars, grouped results in order tickets, clients, contacts, assets, projects, project tasks with up to 5 per group and 'More' per group fetching the next page for that type only
Recent searches (last 8, on device, keyed by server+user) shown before typing with tap-to-search and Clear; cleared on sign-out and host switch
Empty ('No results for …'), error with Retry, offline state; a stale response (older query) is discarded
search i18n namespace
navigation/linking.ts: alga://project/:projectId → ProjectDetail; hosted https://<host>/msp/projects/{id} (no taskId) folds to it; with taskId keeps folding to ProjectTaskDetail
alga://asset/:assetId → AssetDetail; hosted /msp/assets/{id} folds to it
Push routing: notification data with projectId (and no taskId/ticketId) opens ProjectDetail; data with assetId opens AssetDetail

Migration creates api_idempotency_keys (tenant, user_id, key, route, response_status, response_body jsonb, created_at; PK tenant+user_id+key; distributed by tenant)

withIdempotency(route) helper: when Idempotency-Key is present, returns the stored response for (tenant, user, key) if created within 24h, else runs the handler, stores status+body, and returns it; concurrent duplicate within the window waits on the row (insert-first, on conflict read)
Applied to POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/comments, POST /api/v1/time-entries, POST /api/v1/interactions; OpenAPI documents the header; keys older than 24h are ignored (no purge job in scope)

src/offline/outbox.ts: persisted queue (type comment|timeEntry|interaction, payload, idempotencyKey uuid, createdAt, attempts, lastError, status pending|sending|failed) in app storage keyed by baseUrl+tenant+user; enqueue/list/remove/markFailed; cleared on sign-out after the FR40 prompt and on host switch
CommentComposer, time entry form and LogInteractionModal enqueue instead of failing when offline or when the request fails with a network error (not 4xx/5xx); the UI shows 'Saved to outbox'

OutboxRunner replays on reconnect (useNetworkStatus) and on resume, strictly in createdAt order, one at a time; sends Idempotency-Key; success removes the item and invalidates the ticket/time/interaction caches; 4xx → failed with the error, continue; network error → stop
Pending comment renders in the ticket comment list with a Pending badge; pending time entry in the ticket time section; pending interaction in Interactions list; each badge taps to the Outbox screen

OutboxScreen (root 'Outbox', id outbox): items with type, target title, created time, status/error, Retry (resets to pending and runs) and Discard (confirm); header icon with count on every drawer screen while non-empty
Sign-out with a non-empty outbox shows 'n unsent items will be lost' with Cancel / Discard and sign out
